content:
emily: FYI client wants websocket POC + function/tool calls and strict JSON schema. blockers: ephemeral creds, VPC proxy handshake, and rough hosted vs reserved cost. Can someone grab examples?

raj: I'll do the handshake + token rotation snippet. pattern: client gets STS token from their IdP -> proxy mTLS to our control plane -> we return a conn-scoped session token (TTL 4m).

mike: Schema suggestion (compact): `{"tool":"invoice_parser","status":"ok","result":{"total_cents":12345}}`. Add `status: partial` + `errors` for per-page failures. Ask if they accept partials.

emily: They confirmed VPC-only and on-prem KMS wrap. sec-bot: attach standard security questionnaire when ready.

raj: Quick curl for handshake: `curl -X POST https://proxy.acme/v1/handshake --cert client.crt --key client.key -H "Authorization: Bearer <sts>" -d '{"proto":"ws","functions":true}'` -> returns `session_token` + `wss_url`.

mike: Concurrency note: recommend 8 active calls per connection; create multiple connections for parallelism. For cost reductions mention prefix KV caching + 25ms batching.

emily: Pricing ask: they estimate 140 rps sustained. Provide hosted estimate and a Dedicated commit option. I will collate numbers.

sec-bot: repo created: integrations/acme-ws-poc (private).
